clue.text: Pets? Old animal sanctuary taking on a thousand, to breach limit

parts.note: Noah's ark, the old refuge for animals from the Flood

explanation.definitionFit: To overstep the mark is an idiom meaning to go beyond acceptable bounds, breaching a limit.

clue.text: Concealed in copper duct

clue.text: Good-for-nothing drunken Welsh sort

explanation.definitionFit: Worthless and good-for-nothing are synonyms describing someone of no use or value.

clue.text: Criticise what looks like principle of single-member constituencies?

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

the principle is one MP for each constituency, giving EACH

explanation.surface: A wry question about the electoral principle of one representative per seat.
explanation.walkthrough: The principle of single-member constituencies is 'one MP each', which reads I MP EACH.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach is to accuse or call into question, so to criticise someone formally.

clue.text: Smooth over bases of vessels

clue.text: Spread's pointless — time to have a cocktail

clue.text: Predator ripped apart one running away from viewer

parts.note: borne means carried or conveyed

stains are marks or blemishes

the words that a Roman impresario keep the letters inside them

clue.text: Solicitor taking on man's name mostly to escape
